data.bio: Stephanie Vargas De Los Angeles comes from a family with a romantic history - her parents Sandra and Jose Luis were high school sweethearts who were Prom King and Queen of Santa Monica High in 1966. She has a close relationship with her brother Stephen, who shares the same full last name. Stephanie works as a marketing professional and is proud of her family's heritage and the love story of her parents. She values the relationships she has with her extended family, including her Aunt Divine and Uncle Fred, who are the only other known members of her extended family.

work_entries.title: Marketing Manager
work_entries.description: Lead marketing campaigns, manage client relationships, and develop brand strategies.

education_entries.title: Bachelor of Arts in Marketing
education_entries.description: Graduated with focus on marketing and advertising.

data.bio: Stephen Vargas de Los Angeles is Stephanie's brother, sharing the same full last name and family heritage. He works as an engineer and is proud of his family's history, especially the romantic story of his parents being Prom King and Queen. Stephen values the relationships he has with his sister and extended family.

work_entries.title: Mechanical Engineer
work_entries.description: Design mechanical systems, create engineering drawings, and coordinate with manufacturing teams.

education_entries.title: Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering
education_entries.description: Graduated with honors. Focused on mechanical engineering and design.

data.bio: Sandra was the Prom Queen of Santa Monica High in 1966, where she met her future husband Jose Luis, who was the Prom King. Their high school romance blossomed into a lifelong love story. Sandra worked as a teacher and dedicated her life to her family and her students. She is proud of her children Stephanie and Stephen and the family traditions they have maintained.

work_entries.title: Elementary School Teacher
work_entries.description: Taught elementary students, developed lesson plans, and supported student learning for 40 years.

education_entries.title: Bachelor of Science in Education
education_entries.description: Graduated with focus on elementary education.

data.bio: Jose Luis was the Prom King of Santa Monica High in 1966, where he met his future wife Sandra, who was the Prom Queen. Their high school romance blossomed into a lifelong love story. Jose Luis worked as a construction supervisor and provided for his family throughout his career. He is proud of his children Stephanie and Stephen and the family traditions they have maintained.

work_entries.title: Construction Supervisor
work_entries.description: Supervised construction projects, managed crews, and ensured safety compliance for 44 years.

data.bio: Divine is Stephanie and Stephen's aunt, Sandra's sister. She is one of the only other known members of the extended family. Divine works as a nurse and maintains close relationships with her sister's family. She is known for her warm personality and her dedication to her family.

work_entries.title: Registered Nurse
work_entries.description: Provide patient care, administer medications, and support families during medical treatment.

data.bio: Fred is Stephanie and Stephen's uncle, married to Divine and brother-in-law to Jose Luis. He is one of the only other known members of the extended family. Fred works as a mechanic and maintains close relationships with his extended family. He is known for his sense of humor and his willingness to help family members.

work_entries.title: Automotive Mechanic
work_entries.description: Diagnose and repair vehicles, perform routine maintenance, and ensure customer satisfaction.
